stage0090_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「No way...!
　Everyone from $c is in the black hole...!」

stage0090_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$カグラ$$
「So, you answered my call, huh.
　Just as I thought, you're my damn woman.」

stage0090_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What are you talking about, $$シルフィ$$?」

stage0090_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Tch... so those earthquakes since before
　are from that black ball floating in the sky!」

stage0090_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$ゼシカ$$!
　So you got left behind on Altair too!」

stage0090_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I figured it out!
　A way to end this war and save Altair and Vega!」

stage0090_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「To put an end to it all...!
　For that, I need the Wings of the sun...
　the power of $$ソーラーアクエリオン$$!」

stage0090_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You carry Apollo's soul. I know you can do it!」

stage0090_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「If that's what will save everyone...」

stage0090_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Leave it to me, damn woman!
　I'll make it happen!」

stage0090_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
???
「This is inside $$グーラ$$'s heart...
　You've just dived into it.」

stage0090_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
???
「Entering $$グーラ$$'s heart, trapped by
　darkness, isn't possible with your power alone.」

stage0090_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
???
「Go, Mars...
　Banish the darkness deep in $$グーラ$$'s heart.」

stage0090_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$...!
　So the darkness in $$グーラ$$'s heart is him after all!」

stage0090_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$タケル$$
「Wake up, $$グーラ$$!
　$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ might be your father,
　but you must have your own way to live!」

stage0090_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$タケル$$
「Don't listen to $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　Live for what you hold dear!」

stage0090_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's right, $$グーラ$$!
　You have friends, don't you!
　Do you want a killing spree with your friends!?」

stage0090_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
???
「$$グーラ$$!
　I don't want to fight you!!」

stage0090_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　You're my friend!!」

stage0090_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Prince $$グーラ$$ must be pleased, having
　settled things with Master $$正太郎$$.」

stage0090_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Having lost completely, the prince's heart
　was clear, and gave us 100 Z-Chips.
　Of course, I've added them to the squad's stock.」

stage0090_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The next time the prince appears before
　Master $$正太郎$$, will he be foe or friend...
　But I'm sure the two of them are friends...」

stage0090_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry!
　As I'm quite busy again this time,
　I'll have D-Trader run automatically!」

stage0090_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, with that said,
　the ace pilots' celebration is for another time!」

stage0090_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then!
　No matter what happens, business, business!」
